en:
...A pitch-black void stretched out all around me.
Even with my eyes open...
Even with my eyes closed...
All I could see in front of me was darkness...
What on earth had happened?{p}...Oh.
I could see a light, far off in the distance.
Walk toward the light
Walk away from the light
Stay where I am
Before I knew it, I was bathed in a yellow-green light.{p}

A lush green meadow spread out beneath my feet.
Where on earth was I...?
My body felt light, and the soft grass felt so pleasant somehow.
When I took a deep breath, the smell of sun-warmed grass made my head go hazy.
...It's nice to just relax like this once in a while.
As I was thinking that...
"You...
You like plants, don't you...?"
Suddenly, someone spoke to me.{p}

Startled, I looked around, and there was a man standing a little way off.
It was a face I'd never seen before.
Who could he be...?
"Plants are wonderful, aren't they?
If you pour your love into them, they always return it.
They never betray you the way people do..."
With that, the man smiled.
His smile was dazzling.
"What do you say?
Meeting in a place like this must be some kind of fate...
Won't you have some tea with me?"
...Huh.
Is this some new kind of pickup line?
But where exactly does he plan to have tea in a meadow like this...?{p}

I looked all the way around, but all I could see was the vast, vast meadow.
There was nothing else.
"Um...
Tea...?"
After looking all around, I turned back to the man.{p}

...Huh?
Before I knew it, a small table had appeared between the man and me.
On it were two white teacups...
I couldn't see clearly what was inside, but it was a sort of coffee color.
...Where on earth did he get all this?{p}

"Here, please, help yourself."
The man smiled cheerfully as he offered it to me.{p}...What should I do?
Drink it
Don't drink it

"...Um.
Thank you, I'll have some..."
That's what I said, but I didn't reach for the cup.
I mean...
It didn't look very tasty at all.{p}

"This tea is made from a special plant, you see.
It's very good for your health.
I make a point of drinking it every single day."
With that, the man drained the tea in one go, gulping noisily.
And then,{p}

At that moment, a wind came whooshing in, and a green mist blocked my view.
"...nbu......ra..."
I couldn't make out the voice over the rustling of the wind.
Not only that: the man, the table, the teacups, all of it turned green, melted into the mist and vanished.
"Wh-what...★"
I strained my eyes desperately and looked all around.{p}

Then, suddenly, a girl I'd never seen appeared right in front of me.
The girl gave a spiteful smile and,{p}

"You're in the way!"
...she said, and shoved me as hard as she could.{p}

Instantly everything went dark before my eyes.
Through that darkness, my body was plummeting at a terrifying speed.
...I'm falling!
It felt like a bare hand had grabbed my heart, and every hair on my body stood on end.
Even though I was in darkness, I could tell the ground was rushing up toward me.
If I keep falling like this...★
"...I'm going to hit!"{p}

The moment I screamed that, my body slammed into the ground.
A sharp pain shot up from the tips of my feet.{p}
Through my blurry vision, I saw Hosoda's face.{p}

...Is this the newspaper club room?
...Hmm, what was I doing?
My head is throbbing...
There was a blackout a little while ago, wasn't there?
I think I hit my head when it happened...
Did I pass out because of that?{p}

"{a}, are you all right...?"
Saying that, Hosoda peered into my face.
...Ugh.
I know he's worried about me, but I really don't want to see him in close-up...
"I-I'm fine.
Don't worry about me..."
Pretending to look around the room, I turned my face away.{p}

"Oh, I had them go home.
Because...
If everyone were here, it'd be too cramped for the seventh one to fit in, see?"
Hosoda answered with a big smile.
...The seventh one?
Is the seventh one coming now?
But if the seventh one couldn't fit in the room with everyone here...
Could it be someone even fatter than Hosoda...★
"Um, Hosoda...?"
I got worried and asked him.
"Do you know who the seventh one is?"
"What are you talking about?
Oh, come on, {a}...
The seventh one is......"{p}

A man was standing in the doorway.
Is he the seventh one?
There's something familiar about his face...
But I couldn't remember at all where I'd met him.
"Takeuchi!"
It was Hosoda who jumped up happily.{p}Takeuchi, if I remember right, is......
I remember Takeuchi
Who was Takeuchi again...?

Takeuchi is the man from Hosoda's story who never goes to the toilet.
Supposedly he drank some mysterious tea, and his body changed so he no longer needed to go...
But I'm pretty sure that person transferred to another school.
...What!
Tea...★
That's it!
The man I met in the dream I had a moment ago, while I was passed out...
This man is the spitting image of him!
No.
...It's more like Takeuchi appeared in my dream.{p}

"Sorry for being so late.
The transfer paperwork took a bit longer than I expected."
"Huh?
Transfer...?"
...The math doesn't add up.
I mean, he's two years older than Hosoda, isn't he?
Then he should have graduated this past March.
"Ha ha ha...
Do you find it strange that I'm a third-year?
You want to say I should have graduated already, don't you?
The truth is...
I went abroad and took almost a year off from school.
So now I'm doing my third year over again.
Ha ha ha..."{p}

"Then we'll be able to go to school together until next spring!"
...Hosoda seems strangely happy.
I see...
If this man is Takeuchi, that means Hosoda can get that whatever-it-was tea he wanted so badly.{p}

"Well then, allow me to introduce myself properly.
My name is Kiyoshi Takeuchi.
As of today, I'm a student in Class 3-G.
Pleased to meet you...
Now then, shall I tell you the scary story I know?"
And with that, the seventh story, the finale of the seven wonders, finally began.{p}

"Maybe because this school has been standing for such a long time, it has lots of magnificent trees.
A lot of them have been cut down or moved, but the big ginkgo tree beside the new school building is still there, right?
When it comes to the flavors of autumn, you just can't leave out ginkgo nuts.
They smell a bit, but you can't talk about the flavors of autumn without the taste of ginkgo nuts.{p}{a}, have you ever eaten the ginkgo nuts from that tree?"
Yes, I have
No, I haven't

"I see, you haven't.
That's good.
You see, {a}...
That tree has another name: the Suicide Tree.
Why...?
It's simple.
Because so many students kill themselves under that tree.
Hanging themselves, taking sleeping pills... the ways they die vary.
But every body found under that tree is a suicide.
And every one of them is a girl.{p}

...See? Strange, isn't it?
That's the scary story I know."
"That's all?"
Isn't that a bit too weak to be the finale of the seven wonders?{p}
...Hmm, I feel like it needs a little something more.{p}

"{a}...
Now, hold on.
Don't be in such a hurry to reach a conclusion.
I heard this story when I was a first-year...
Back then, I had no idea at all why only girls killed themselves.
I only found the answer very recently.
...Mind you, it's not as if I'd been searching for that answer the whole time.
The way I arrived at the answer was nothing but pure chance.
...Hosoda, you knew about Sanbura tea, didn't you?"
"Y-yes!"
"The truth is...
The reason I went abroad was that I wanted to research Sanbura tea in more detail.
I thought, if only it could be grown in Japan too...{p}

The Sanbura tea we drank at my house was always something my father bought in India.
So I thought researching Sanbura tea would be easy once I went to India.
But it turned out to be far harder work than I'd imagined.
No matter where I went, I couldn't find any Sanbura tea.{p}

When I asked the locals, they told me that the plant Sanbura tea is made from, called the Sanbura tree, had declined sharply over the past few years and was now nearly extinct.
I panicked.
I'd come all the way from Japan, and now I couldn't find any Sanbura tea? You've got to be kidding!
I searched desperately.
I must have wandered through the primeval forest for over half a year, looking for a wild Sanbura tree.
And at last, I managed to find the plant.{p}

It was truly a sight out of a dream.
A gigantic tree was growing in the middle of the tropical primeval forest.
It really was a magnificent tree.
At first, I didn't even realize it was a single tree.
Earth-colored roots and vines stretched out in every direction, and the whole area was like a jungle.
But...
The vines that covered everything were completely withered, and every time the wind blew, they crumbled away from the tips.
The thick roots crawling over the ground were rotted to mush, and if you stepped on one carelessly, a thick yellow-green sap oozed out and gave off a foul stench.{p}

...The tree was already dead.
Even plants have a life span, after all.
I examined that tree down to every last corner.
And as a result, I found out why the Sanbura tree is on the verge of extinction.{p}

And that also turned out to be the key to solving the mystery of the strange incidents caused by that ginkgo beside the new school building.
Say, {a}...
Earlier, I asked if you'd ever eaten the nuts from the ginkgo tree beside the new school building.
You said you hadn't.
...Naturally.{p}

Because that tree doesn't bear any fruit.
That ginkgo is a male tree.
You know about that, don't you?
Ginkgo trees come in male trees and female trees...
In other words, what we'd call men and women in humans.
Apparently, before the new school building went up, there was a row of ginkgo trees around there.
But when the new school building was built, they were all cut down except that one.
Plants have feelings too, you know...
I'd guess that ginkgo is lonely.
It's all alone and lonely, so it calls all sorts of people to it.
...Come.
Come here...
Give up being human, and live with me...
Whispers like that ride on the wind and beckon people.
I think only girls get called because, after all, the ginkgo is a male tree.{p}

...That's why girls kill themselves under the ginkgo.
The Sanbura tree, like the ginkgo and the cycad, is a plant with separate male and female trees.
It's facing extinction because female trees are overwhelmingly outnumbered by male ones.
At this rate, no one will ever be able to drink Sanbura tea again!
Thinking that, I studied the Sanbura tree's ecology with all my might, determined to protect it somehow.
And at last, I succeeded in a certain kind of selective breeding."
With that, Takeuchi twisted the corner of his mouth into a smile.
"And the tea that came of it is... this."{p}

"S-Sanbura tea...☆"
Hosoda gulped.
...He's been dying to drink it, after all.
"Takeuchi......"
Hosoda gazed at Takeuchi with pleading eyes.
But...{p}

"No, Hosoda.
You spat it out last time, didn't you?
I can't let someone like that drink precious Sanbura tea.
Besides, I blended this cup especially for {a}, and no one else."{p}

"......Oh."
Flatly turned down, Hosoda was utterly crestfallen.{p}

"{a}...
Go on, drink it."
Takeuchi smiled cheerfully as he offered me the tea.{p}...It's exactly like my dream.
Drink it
Don't drink it

"......"
I didn't drink the tea.
I mean, if what Hosoda said is true, drinking this tea turns you into a human-plant hybrid, right?
Even if it didn't, it doesn't look very tasty at all.
I don't even want to put my lips to it.
"What's wrong, {a}...?
There's no need to be shy.
This cup is my offering to you."
Slowly, Takeuchi's face drew closer to mine.{p}

"{a}...
Just drink this one cup down, and your whole life will become wonderful.
Listen to me.
You're the first woman I've ever offered this tea to.
That's how much I like you."
Under Takeuchi's skin, small green things were squirming around.
On his forehead...
On his cheeks...
On the tip of his nose, even in his eyeballs...
"Come now, {a}..."
Every time Takeuchi opened his mouth, his grassy breath blew over me.
The same smell as the sun-warmed grass I'd breathed in the dream...{p}

...My head was going hazy, deep inside.
Just then...{p}

"Do wait just a moment!"
The door flew open, and a girl appeared.
She had her arms folded, and her attitude was somehow haughty.
I felt like I'd seen her somewhere before.
...Who on earth is she?
Those defiant eyes, that strong-willed mouth...
I'm sure I've met her somewhere.
But where......?
...It's no use.
I just can't remember.
The girl strode right up to me and looked me over from the top of my head to the tips of my toes, as if licking me with her eyes.
And then,
"So you're {b} {a} of Class 1-E."
she said, with a little snort.
...Hmph!
What a nasty attitude.
She certainly seems like an upperclassman, but hasn't anyone taught her any manners★
"Yes.
I'm {a}, but who are you?"
I asked curtly.{p}

"Oh, pardon me.
I am Sakurako Kosaka, of Class 3-G.
A pleasure..."
With that, Kosaka held out her right hand.
...A handshake, huh.
I held out my right hand too.
And we gripped each other's hands firmly...
...Ugh, she's so strong★
Without moving so much as an eyebrow, Kosaka squeezed my hand with every ounce of strength she had.
A smile that looked pasted on...
But her eyes weren't smiling at all.
Slowly letting go of my hand, Kosaka muttered under her breath,
"And I told you that you were in the way..."{p}

"Honestly, {a}, really...
To refuse the Sanbura tea that not even I, Sakurako, captain of Lord Kiyoshi Takeuchi's Guard, have ever been granted the honor of drinking...
What a presumptuous girl you are!"
...What do you expect me to do about that!
If I don't want to drink something, I absolutely won't drink it.
That's what I hate about fans: there's something scary about how unpredictable they are.
Sure, Hosoda did say Takeuchi was a huge hit with the girls...
But I never imagined he was popular enough to have his own guard.{p}
What kind of people could be in it, I wonder...{p}

"Lord Takeuchi...
Why did you offer Sanbura tea to a girl like this?
For your sake, Lord Takeuchi, Sakurako would gladly offer up her very self..."
Kosaka was gazing at Takeuchi with moist eyes.
Does she like this guy that much?{p}

"...Is that so?
Well then, you... it was Sakurako, wasn't it?
I suppose you'll do.
Drink this tea down for me, would you?"
That eerie smile was still stuck on Takeuchi's face.
...I wonder why.
I have a bad feeling about this.
It's as if something evil were moving in the shadows...
But Kosaka didn't notice a thing.
"Yes...!
Oh, Lord Takeuchi...
Sakurako is so happy."{p}

Saying that, Kosaka gave a melting smile and gently picked up the teacup.
Then she drained it in one gulp.
To think she could gulp down something that looked that vile...
The power of love is truly something.{p}

"...Aww, man."
The one who muttered that in disappointment was Hosoda.
No wonder: the tea he'd been searching for had been gulped down right in front of him.
...Clink.
The cup was set down with a small sound.
Not a single drop of the blackish liquid was left.{p}

Kosaka smiled proudly and gazed at Takeuchi.
Then,
"Takeuchi..."
she called his name tenderly.{p}

At that instant, with a slithering hiss, a green vine came stretching out of Kosaka's mouth.
"Eek!"{p}

"Ha ha ha..."
Takeuchi's laughter soon broke that silence.
"Ha ha ha...
I'm so happy.
{a} gave me the slip, but this girl would do just as well, really.
Now I'm not alone.
I won't be lonely anymore.
Ah ha ha ha..."
Along with Takeuchi's laughter, a wind came rushing in with a whoosh.{p}
The wind had carried a green mist in from out of nowhere.{p}

As if erased by that green mist, Takeuchi vanished from sight.
...It's exactly the same as in my dream.
"Takeuchi...★"
The moment Takeuchi disappeared, a sudden gust blew in.
The gust blew away the green mist that had robbed us of our view, and everything cleared.{p}

...It all happened in the blink of an eye.
When the green storm had passed, Takeuchi and Kosaka were gone.
Only the two of us were left: Hosoda, standing there dumbfounded, and me...

We just stood there without a word.
I don't know how much time passed...
I was the first to speak.
"Shall we go home...?"{p}

...Several days passed after that.
I heard through the rumor mill later that there was no transfer student named Takeuchi in Class 3-G.{p}
As for the student named Kiyoshi Takeuchi who used to attend this school, they say he went abroad to search for a phantom plant and was never heard from again...{p}

Back then...
Who on earth was it that appeared before Hosoda and me?
They vanished along with the green mist...
Where did they go?{p}

Today, I finished the manuscript for the seven wonders.
...The seventh of the seven wonders is the story of a mysterious tree.
Around the time a girl from Class 3-G went missing and became the talk of the whole school...
an unfamiliar sapling sprang up next to the big ginkgo tree beside the new school building.
That sapling, about the same height as me, somehow calls to mind a girl twisting her body.
A sapling that sprang up suddenly one night...
This tree is a human girl who changed form.
If you were careless enough to snap off a branch, bright red blood would surely flow from the cut.
If you think I'm lying, I recommend you try it.
Though I can't guarantee you'll live...
Come on, reach out your arm, ever so gently...
Pinch a thin branch and apply just a little force, that's all.{p}

...I wonder what's over that way?
I started walking in the direction away from the light.
I just kept on walking through the pitch-dark space.
I don't know how long I walked...
Pitch-black darkness spread out before my eyes.
Darkness, darkness, darkness...
It didn't look like this view would change even if I kept walking.
When I happened to look back, I could still see the light, small as a dot.
I'd thought I'd gotten quite far from it, but maybe I hadn't gone that far after all.
Can I still go back...?
I decided to turn around and walk toward the light.
Then the light, which had looked like a tiny dot, grew bigger and bigger...{p}
Before I knew it, I was bathed in a yellow-green light.{p}
The moment I thought that, I was already bathed in a yellow-green light.{p}

"...Um.
Then I'll have some..."
With that, I timidly put my lips to the cup.
...Ugh!
What is this taste...☆{p}

It tasted like you'd taken milk left out under the blazing sun for a week as a base, tossed in chunks of celery, run it all through a juicer, and then finished it off by stewing beetle grubs in it...
I only had one sip, but I had a terrible struggle just getting that one sip down.
I could feel my face turning pale, then red, over and over.
And right in front of me, that man was calmly drinking the same tea as if it were nothing.{p}

Takeuchi... who was that again...?
He isn't a senior from the newspaper club... so......
Someone from a club I went to interview before?
Or someone on the same committee as me?
I think there was someone like that among the student council officers...
...But wait a minute.
If Hosoda called out to him, he must be someone Hosoda knows.
Oh! Now I remember.{p}

"What?
...You have?
Now that's a surprise.
You see, {a}...
That tree has another name: the Suicide Tree.
Why...?
It's simple.
Because so many students kill themselves under that tree.
Hanging themselves, taking sleeping pills... the ways they die vary.
But every body found under that tree is a suicide.
And every one of them is a girl.{p}

...See? Strange, isn't it?
That's the scary story I know."
"That's all?"
Isn't that a bit too weak to be the finale of the seven wonders?{p}
...Hmm, I feel like it needs a little something more.{p}

"{a}...
Now, hold on.
Don't be in such a hurry to reach a conclusion.
I heard this story when I was a first-year...
Back then, I had no idea at all why only girls killed themselves.
I only found the answer very recently.
...Mind you, it's not as if I'd been searching for that answer the whole time.
The way I arrived at the answer was nothing but pure chance.
...Hosoda, you knew about Sanbura tea, didn't you?"
"Y-yes!"
"The truth is...
The reason I went abroad was that I wanted to research Sanbura tea in more detail.
I thought, if only it could be grown in Japan too...{p}

The Sanbura tea we drank at my house was always something my father bought in India.
So I thought researching Sanbura tea would be easy once I went to India.
But it turned out to be far harder work than I'd imagined.
No matter where I went, I couldn't find any Sanbura tea.{p}

When I asked the locals, they told me that the plant Sanbura tea is made from, called the Sanbura tree, had declined sharply over the past few years and was now nearly extinct.
I panicked.
I'd come all the way from Japan, and now I couldn't find any Sanbura tea? You've got to be kidding!
I searched desperately.
I must have wandered through the primeval forest for over half a year, looking for a wild Sanbura tree.
And at last, I managed to find the plant.{p}

It was truly a sight out of a dream.
A gigantic tree was growing in the middle of the tropical primeval forest.
It really was a magnificent tree.
At first, I didn't even realize it was a single tree.
Earth-colored roots and vines stretched out in every direction, and the whole area was like a jungle.
But...
The vines that covered everything were completely withered, and every time the wind blew, they crumbled away from the tips.
The thick roots crawling over the ground were rotted to mush, and if you stepped on one carelessly, a thick yellow-green sap oozed out and gave off a foul stench.{p}

...The tree was already dead.
Even plants have a life span, after all.
I examined that tree down to every last corner.
And as a result, I found out why the Sanbura tree is on the verge of extinction.{p}

And that also turned out to be the key to solving the mystery of the strange incidents caused by that ginkgo beside the new school building.
Say, {a}...
Earlier, I asked if you'd ever eaten the nuts from the ginkgo tree beside the new school building.
You said you had.
But that's a lie.{p}

"Well then, I'll have some..."
I didn't really want to drink it, but I don't think even this experience will go to waste.
If it's for the sake of writing a good article, I can put up with it even if it tastes a bit awful.
...Still, I'd rather pass on having green plants crawling around under my skin.
It's fine if I just take one little lick, right?
With those thoughts in mind, I picked up the cup.
Timidly, I brought my face close to it.
...And a grassy smell stung my nose, so strong it made me feel sick.
Ma...
Maybe I'll pass after all...
That thought suddenly crossed my mind.
...Just then!{p}

...Ah!
By the time I thought that, it was too late.{p}

"Aaaaaah☆"
The moment he saw it, Hosoda let out a scream of despair.
"My...
My Sanbura tea...
Uuh, hic..."
He plopped down on the floor in front of the broken cup and started crying.
He's just like a little kid.
Does he even realize it's his own fault?{p}

"{a}...
Looks like we're in no state to go on with the story."
Takeuchi spoke to me with a wry smile.
He's absolutely right.
It's enough to make me feel like I don't care about the seven wonders anymore.
And Hosoda doesn't look like he's going to stop crying anytime soon...
"Takeuchi...
I'm sorry, but would it be all right if I came to hear the story another day?"
"Sure, I don't mind at all.
I'll blend a very special tea and be waiting for you."{p}
We left the school, leaving the crying Hosoda behind.{p}

...And then, the next day.
"{a}...
{a}..."
As I was walking down the hallway in front of my classroom, a voice suddenly called out to stop me.
It was a voice I'd heard before.
But there was no one in front of me.
Even when I turned around, there was nobody there.
I was the only one in the hallway...
...And yet,{p}

"{a}...
I'm over heeere."
......What?
I looked at the window and froze in shock.
Hosoda, with a green head, was peering in from outside the window.
This is... the third floor, isn't it?
The moment I thought that, I felt myself slipping away.{p}
......How long was I unconscious?{p}

"Are you all right, {a}?"
Takeuchi's voice brought me around.
It looks like this is the nurse's office.
For some reason, the window blinds are closed.
Did Takeuchi carry me here?
Or was it Hosoda...?
...Oh!
"Wh-where's Hosoda...★"
Takeuchi pointed at the other bed, beaming.{p}

Hosoda was there.
He was sitting on the bed, hunched up small, holding his head.
There didn't seem to be anything especially different about him.
Then what on earth was that just now...?{p}

"Listen, {a}.
Yesterday I told you I'd improved the breed, didn't I?
The new Sanbura tea I made has the effect of changing your constitution.
Into one just like a plant's.
Then you can live on nothing but water, light and air.
Don't you think that's wonderful?"
"...Um."
But what does that have to do with anything?
The cup of yesterday's Sanbura tea broke before I'd taken a single sip...
......Oh☆{p}
Bright sunlight came flooding in.

Instantly, Hosoda's neck began to twitch and quiver...
and it stretched out, longer and longer, toward the window.{p}

"Listen, {a}.
This is the property of plants to bend and grow toward light: 'phototropism.'
Educational, isn't it?"
Takeuchi seemed strangely pleased.
Maybe he was happy to see the results of his research in an unexpected place.
And as for me, my sense of mission as a newspaper club member was swelling up inside my head.{p}

...With this, my interview will be complete!
The seventh of the seven wonders is,
"Bizarre! Rokurokubi Man Appears at School"
...That settles it.{p}Though maybe it sounds a little like a sideshow at an old-time festival stall...?{p}
